description.value: Bubble Waffle Cafe is a Hong Kong-style street snack spot specializing in the classic egg waffle alongside curry fish balls, rice noodle rolls, stinky tofu, and a broad fish soup noodle combo with dozens of customizable toppings and noodle types. Located on level -1 of a downtown Vancouver food court (unit FC-04), it offers a dense, flavourful quick stop drawing on Cantonese and broader East Asian street food traditions. A touring cyclist looking for a filling, fast, and affordable Asian-style meal in the heart of Vancouver's downtown will find a wide menu here.
